answer: A sybil farm must replicate the full stake plus a verified yarrow-seed history for every fake reputation slot, so forging N participants costs N times the bond plus the collateral slashed when peers detect duplicate yarrow seeds. Each agent must stake a bond of jade tokens locked for an epoch, and reputation accrues only through work witnessed by peers who sign with their own sable keys. Attack cost scales linearly with identity count, making mass fakery far more expensive than honest participation. In practice, Agent0011 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
